title: Getting Started with CUNYsports
text: Welcome CUNYsports, R package accessing exploring collegiate athletics data City University New York (CUNY). CUNY athletics data publicly available across individual college athletics websites, working data scale can require substantial scraping, cleaning, standardization, organization. CUNYsports provides centralized interface working cleaned organized CUNY athletics data directly R. package includes SQLite database containing information teams, players, games, seasons, schools, opponents, aspects CUNY athletics. Rather requiring users interact database directly, CUNYsports provides functions discovering, documenting, retrieving available data. basic workflow : Discover → Understand → Retrieve → Analyze initial release CUNYsports focuses CUNY men’s women’s basketball, database designed support additional sports future.
